fusions.name: Hissed Syllable
fusions.desc: A spoken hiss at an enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 5 arcane damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Swaying Gaze
fusions.desc: Sends a mesmerising pulse that deals 14 arcane damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1.4 seconds and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Well-Rehearsed Hiss
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Spell on the Scent
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
